name: SwitchBot Hub 2 (EU)

radios.note: 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi only and Bluetooth LE; it also has an IR blaster. CSA listing is for the global Hub 2; the EU SKU is not confirmed there.

matter.note: CSA lists the Woan Technology Hub (SKU W3202100, certified 2023); no EU-specific SKU confirmed. The hub joins the network only over Wi-Fi, so Matter runs over Wi-Fi.

apple_home.note: Through the Matter bridge; needs a HomePod or Apple TV as the Matter controller. Only some SwitchBot device types are bridged.

google_home.note: SwitchBot Smart in Works with Google. Matter pairing to Google Home also works.

alexa.note: SwitchBot Smart skill. Matter also works.

smartthings.note: SwitchBot's Matter-over-Bridge guide has a SmartThings section. Only some SwitchBot device types are bridged.

home_assistant.note: Home Assistant's SwitchBot Matter page lists devices certified via Hub 2 or Hub 3.

hubRequired.note: It is the hub that SwitchBot's Bluetooth devices connect through.

localControl.note: Not confirmed from an official source.

deviceProtocols.note: Talks to SwitchBot Bluetooth devices and learns IR remotes.

matterBridge.note: SwitchBot lists Hub 2 as a Matter bridge for some SwitchBot devices and IR appliances; check SwitchBot's compatibility list for which types pass.

maxDevices.note: SwitchBot gives 8 as the number of sub-devices Hub 2 can sync to Apple or Google over Matter, a bridge limit rather than a total.

summary: SwitchBot Hub 2 connects SwitchBot devices and IR appliances over 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi and Bluetooth. Google Home and Alexa work through SwitchBot's own integrations, while Apple Home, SmartThings and Home Assistant get them through the hub's Matter bridge, which syncs up to 8 sub-devices to Apple or Google.

caveats: Hub 2 joins 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi, and Matter runs over Wi-Fi.
The Matter bridge syncs up to 8 sub-devices to Apple or Google, and only some SwitchBot device types are bridged; check SwitchBot's compatibility list.
Apple Home needs a HomePod or Apple TV as the Matter controller.
